source.test: loadSlots(forServerDir:) per-entry tolerance feeding State 2 resolution — see docs/msc2/worlds/phase6-scope.md §"MSC 1's own active-slot resolution" and §"State 2 — world_slots only"

expected.valid_slot_resolved_via: newest-created fallback (no slot in the loaded set has lastPlayedAt set)

notes: Distinguishes 'corrupt slot metadata' from the fully-unresolvable case in missing-or-corrupt-active-marker-with-live-and-slots.json: here loadSlots' per-entry tolerance (line 305-311, characterized directly in load-slots-corrupt-entry-skipped.json) skips the two corrupt entries but still returns slot-valid, so resolvedActiveSlotID's guard (line 130) never fires -- there IS a resolvable active slot, just not via the explicit marker (absent here) or lastPlayedAt (unset), so it falls to the newest-createdAt branch (line 143). Reconciliation proceeds down the normal State 2 path using only the one recoverable slot; the two corrupt slot directories are left on disk untouched rather than deleted, in case a later repair pass can recover them.
